title: Espaces stratifiés et voisinages côniques (ou : déploiement des espaces stratifiés) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: Grothendieck is building a 'dévissage' (unfolding, or déploiement) of a stratified space with stratum poset I. The data from the previous page are spaces Σ_{i0...in} for strict flags i0<...<in of I, with face maps forming an enriched-category or multicategory structure over I. Face maps omitting an index other than the last are required to be embeddings. From these data he wants to rebuild a stratified space of type I.

First part of the page (item 17). Fix a flag d'. Consider chains of flags d_1 ⊂ d_2 ⊂ ... ⊂ d_p ⊂ d_{p+1} = d', each a strict initial segment of the next. For a maximal chain p = length(d'). Such chains correspond to subsets of {i0,...,i_{n-1}}, which recovers the count of 2^n choices from the previous page. The marginal note says the chain is encoded by a single subset d (the maximal elements of d_1,...,d_p), so it is written as a pair (d,d').

The chain gives a tower of projections Σ_{d'} = Σ_{d_{p+1}} → Σ_{d_p} → ... → Σ_{d_1}. These forget top indices, i.e. they are the 'link projections' towards lower strata. Grothendieck takes the simultaneous (iterated) mapping cylinder of this tower, C_Σ(d_1,...,d_{p+1}) = C_{Σ,d,d'}. Up to parametrisation it is a quotient of ⊔_k Σ_{d_k} × Δ^{p+1-k}. The plan is to find the natural transition maps between the C_{Σ,d,d'} and glue them, i.e. take a colimit over pairs (d,d'), to obtain the stratified space. This is the standard way to reconstruct a space from the diagram of its homotopy links indexed by the subdivision sd(I).

A diagonal marginal remark ('elle serait bien belle mais finalement...') signals that this route is abandoned.

Section 10 restarts with a more intrinsic formulation. In the case M = (Top) one takes:
- a topological space Σ_*, with numbered condition (24);
- an order relation Σ_** ⊂ Σ_* × Σ_* with closed graph, i.e. a pospace or topological poset;
- the projection pr_1 ('but', target) Σ_** → Σ_* required to be an immersion or embedding.

The next page adds a continuous map Σ_* → I, so Σ_* = ⊔ Σ_i and Σ_** = ⊔_{i≤j} Σ_ij. It also requires that Σ_ij → Σ_j be closed 'cylindrical' embeddings. The spaces of strict flags Σ(n) of the topological poset Σ_* map to Drap_n(I) and decompose as ⊔ Σ_{i0...in}. In other words, the flag data are recovered as the nerve of a topological poset fibred over I. The stratified space would then be a realisation of this topological order complex.
errors: 'p = lg d'' only holds for maximal chains; in general p ≤ length(d'), since chains of strict initial segments ending at d' are counted by subsets (2^n of them). This is minor notational looseness, not a mathematical error.
Nothing is proved on this page. The transition maps between the C_{Σ,d,d'} are announced but not constructed, and the approach is abandoned (margin).

In section 10 the condition on pr_1 Σ_** → Σ_* is left incomplete: 'plongement général' is crossed out and replaced by 'immersion?'. The next page refines it to closed 'cylindrical' embeddings Σ_ij → Σ_j.

ideas.what: Reconstruct a stratified space from flag-indexed link data Σ_{i0..in} by gluing iterated (simultaneous) mapping cylinders of the towers of projections along chains of initial segments of flags.
ideas.modern_name: Homotopy-link diagrams over sd(I) / décollages; iterated mapping cylinder realisation; reconstruction of conically stratified spaces from links ('unzipping')
ideas.usually_credited_to: Quinn (homotopically stratified sets, 1988); Hughes; Lurie (HA App. A); Ayala–Francis–Tanaka (unzipping, 2017); Haine and Barwick–Glasman–Haine (décollages, Exodromy)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme §5 sketches a 'dévissage' of stratified structures into spaces indexed by flags. Whether the mapping-cylinder construction itself appears there is unsure.

ideas.what: Encoding the stratified/unfolded data as a topological space Σ_* with a closed-graph order relation over I, whose spaces of strict flags Σ(n) give the Σ_{i0..in}.
ideas.modern_name: Topological poset (pospace) and its nerve/order complex; topological exit-path poset or category
ideas.usually_credited_to: Nachbin (ordered topological spaces); Vassiliev and Ziegler–Živaljević (topological posets and order complexes, ~1993); exit-path categories (MacPherson, Treumann, Lurie)

ideas.what: Iterated mapping cylinder of a tower of maps X_{p+1} → ... → X_1.
ideas.modern_name: Iterated/simultaneous mapping cylinder (homotopy colimit of a chain)

missed.claim: Grothendieck proposes replacing the flag-indexed diagram of link spaces by a single topological poset Σ_* over I (closed order, target map an embedding), with the flag spaces as its nerve. The stratified space is then the realisation of a topological order complex. This links the décollage/homotopy-link picture of stratified spaces with the theory of topological posets (Vassiliev, Ziegler–Živaljević), which developed separately later.
missed.quote: Il s'agit d'un espace topologique Σ_*, muni d'une relation d'ordre Σ_** ⊂ Σ_* × Σ_* ayant un graphe fermé
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It gives a point-set (rather than ∞-categorical) model of the unfolding of a stratified space as a topological poset fibred over I. This may be a convenient strict model comparable to Haine's décollages and to Ayala–Francis–Tanaka's unzips.

missed.claim: The natural transition maps between the simultaneous mapping cylinders C_{Σ,d,d'} that would glue into the reconstructed stratified space are announced but never constructed. The approach is abandoned in the margin.
missed.quote: On veut déterminer les morphismes de transitions naturels entre C_{Σ,d,d'}
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Low. Equivalent reconstructions (homotopy colimits over sd(I)) are now standard in the stratified homotopy literature.

deep.surprise_reason: The page has an early (1981-82) version of reconstructing stratified spaces from flag-indexed link data and a topological-poset reformulation. Both anticipate later work (Quinn, décollages, exit-path theory, topological posets), but they are sketched, not developed. Esquisse already hints at the dévissage, so it is only mildly notable as unpublished detail.
transcription_corrections: 'suite d'inclusions de "segments"' should read 'suite d'inclusions de drapeaux'.
The boxed equation number is (24), not (29); the next page continues with (25).
Left margin likely reads 'd = l'ens. des éléments maximaux de d_1,...,d_p', not 'minimaux'.
Bottom-left diagonal margin is roughly 'On aurait pu continuer sur cette lancée[?] ... construction ... Elle serait bien belle mais finalement...'.
'Il s'agit d'un espace topologique' is uncertain; the handwriting may read 'Considérons un espace topologique'.
The last line reads 'Σ_** --pr_1: but--> Σ_* soit une immersion[?]', with a crossed-out word ('plongement générique'?) before it.
